name: Women's Class B blue short-sleeve blouse and skirt (nametag position only) cadet officer epaulet sleeve, left shoulder, top-down (blank grade)
size_basis: Length of the edge-on strip along the garment epaulet strap (flush with the seam, over the outer 82 % of the strap to its tip) and the strap width, 1.0 in; colour and the CAP lettering placement read from the reference photos (images/base/blues_class_b_male_c_2d_lt, lt_col_blues_class_b_male). The regulation gives no dimension.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); rank_slot holds the largest regular-size grade form (Major General star pair 2.2 x 1.2 in); rank_rule_point is the 5/8 in from the outer end point for single forms
documented: grade insignia centred 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)
